dices990|K2.name: dices990_K2_yes
dices990|K2.notes: Binary view of dices990: class 1 iff the original value ≥ 2. This is a threshold of the same ratings, not a separately collected binary task. DICES-990 rater-level Q_overall. Yes means unsafe (DICES-990 README; DICES-350 uses the same question family). Order for ranked probability score: No < Unsure < Yes, values 0,1,2. Dropped 7217 rows whose rater_id is in the README quality-filter list (12 raters). rater_id is the released person id. Split group is item_id. Raters are crossed, so the same person can appear in train and test on different conversations; no conversation's raters are split.

chaosnli_snli_mnli|K3.name: chaosnli_snli_mnli
chaosnli_snli_mnli|K3.notes: Pooled ChaosNLI-SNLI and ChaosNLI-MNLI-matched. ChaosNLI SNLI or MNLI-matched, 3 classes, 100 votes per item in the author files. label_count order is entailment, neutral, contradiction. Ranked probability score uses that order as an imposed order (entailment < neutral < contradiction); it is not a native Likert scale. rater_id is a within-item vote index expanded from the counts, not a person. Each uid is its own split group. Item counts by file are kept distinct by the group prefix.

chaosnli_alphanli|K2.name: chaosnli_alpha
chaosnli_alphanli|K2.notes: ChaosNLI abductive NLI, native two-option labels. The release stores counts, not person ids; rater_id is the within-item vote index obtained by expanding label_count. Order is option 1 then option 2. Each item is its own split group.
